Traffic is still an encouraging one Ishaga bus stop towards Fagba.
It moves slowly from Alamutu towards Fagba intersection due to morning influx of Vehicular movement, bus stop activities and ongoing alternation at Fagba.

Inward and outward of Jonathan Coker is fair.

Fagba moving ahead to Jungle, Ifako international looks good except for the traffic light alternation delay.
